visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a decorative bouquet featuring strawberries, LED lights, and a small white cartoon plushie (Chiikawa) holding a strawberry. The lighting is bright and warm, set against a blurred indoor home background. (2) Medium shot of a young Asian woman with reddish-brown hair in a ponytail, wearing a black off-the-shoulder top, holding the bouquet and smiling cheerfully. (3) Hands present a medium-sized Ziploc-branded plastic bag over a white marble countertop. (4) Hands use scissors to cut the plastic bag into sections for wrapping. (5) A series of close-ups showing hands placing strawberries on plastic holders and wrapping them tightly in clear plastic film. (6) Eight wrapped strawberries are laid out on the counter next to plastic sticks. (7) Hands use scissors to trim the length of a translucent plastic stick. (8) Hands methodically push the strawberry-topped sticks into a grey rectangular floral foam block. (9) Hands use a white zip tie to secure the limbs of a white bear-like plushie. (10) The plushie is taped to a plastic stick and inserted into the foam block behind the strawberries. (11) The base of the foam is wrapped in clear cellophane, followed by large sheets of white tissue paper which are crumpled by hand to add texture. (12) The paper is secured with clear tape and excess edges are trimmed with scissors. (13) A maroon translucent ribbon is tied into a large bow at the front of the bouquet base. (14) Hands carefully wrap a string of warm white LED lights around the strawberries. (15) A small white brand tag with 'Anjou' is placed into the bouquet. (16) The woman reappears holding the finished, glowing bouquet, talking directly to the camera with high energy.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我做了草莓花束. (2) [Subtitle]: 看到網路上有人分享 很可愛 (花店的商品). (3) [Subtitle]: 所以我也想做一束給自己. (4) [Subtitle]: 我用了最簡單的方式來做. (5) [Subtitle]: 拿出M號的密實袋. [Logo]: Ziploc. (6) [Subtitle]: 從中間剪開. (7) [Subtitle]: 再從中間剪開. (8) [Subtitle]: 把草莓當氣球 對準氣球棍. (9) [Subtitle]: 就是要用袋子 那個尖尖的角. (10) [Subtitle]: 可以把草莓包得很漂亮 (還是食品級的材質). (11) [Subtitle]: 包了大概8顆草莓. (12) [Subtitle]: 氣球棍太長的部分剪掉. (13) [Subtitle]: 一支一支 讓他們在花泥就定位. (14) [Variety]: (療癒的聲音). (15) [Subtitle]: 然後再用束帶 把吉伊的手腳都固定起來. (16) [Subtitle]: 有種在犯罪的感覺. (17) [Subtitle]: 再用膠帶把他 固定在氣球棍上. (18) [Subtitle]: 吉伊降臨～. (19) [Subtitle]: 欸...前面再加一顆好了. (20) [Subtitle]: 再鋪一張玻璃紙 把他們再固定起來. (21) [Subtitle]: 然後出動雪梨紙. (22) [Subtitle]: 盡情把他揉成一團. (23) [Subtitle]: 再把一細氣球棍放進去. (24) [Subtitle]: 小心翼翼地往中間推. (25) [Subtitle]: 就變成一個澎澎的樣子了. (26) [Subtitle]: 大概三張包住草莓. (27) [Subtitle]: 用膠帶固定. (28) [Subtitle]: 再把多餘的紙剪掉. (29) [Subtitle]: 最後再包上一層玻璃紙 增加他的層次. (30) [Subtitle]: 多的剪掉. (31) [Subtitle]: 最後是畫龍點睛的緞帶 (很多最後). (32) [Subtitle]: 一定要綁緞帶的吧. (33) [Subtitle]: 將將. (34) [Subtitle]: 還沒完喔 我們還要繞LED燈. (35) [Subtitle]: 哇～他有三段閃爍模式. (36) [Subtitle]: 但覺得前面有點空空的 所以我再加了 自己簽名的小紙條. (37) [Subtitle]: 完成～. (38) [Subtitle]: 是不是蠻有樣子的. (39) [Subtitle]: 實在是有點成就感耶. (40) [Subtitle]: 你也來做一束送人吧.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with reddish-brown hair in a ponytail, wearing a black off-the-shoulder top and blue jeans.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern indoor home setting with a grey sofa, cushions, a wooden cabinet, and a white round coffee table. Indoor lighting is bright and soft.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female voice begins narration over a bright, synthesized pop BGM with a steady 4/4 electronic drum beat. The tone is enthusiastic and high-pitched. (2) Sharp metallic 'snip' sound of scissors cutting plastic, followed by the high-frequency rustling of a Ziploc bag. (3) Continuous rustling of plastic film and soft percussive 'taps' as strawberries are handled. (4) Repeated, rapid percussive 'thuds' as plastic sticks are poked into a dense foam block, synced with narration. (5) Distinct mechanical 'clicking' sound of a plastic zip tie being tightened, twice. (6) High-pitched sound of adhesive tape being pulled from a reel and pressed down. (7) Loud, broadband crinkling noise of paper being crumpled, briefly masking the BGM. (8) Sound of scissors slicing through multiple layers of paper. (9) Soft clicking of LED lights being switched on. (10) The voice becomes satisfied and melodic, concluding with a rising intonation as the BGM maintains its upbeat tempo to the fade out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Material Presentation -> Step-by-step assembly -> Refinement -> Final Showcase -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a creative DIY tutorial demonstrating how to craft a visually appealing strawberry bouquet combined with a character plushie. It targets a lifestyle-oriented audience interested in gift-making and 'kawaii' aesthetics, using fast-paced editing and energetic narration to make the process seem accessible and fun.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Ziploc bag is used as a tool rather than being the focus of a promotion.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high text density and ASMR-like sound effects of crafting materials to enhance engagement.
